method: Independent empty HTML page with ordinary native requestAnimationFrame continuously running. CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride changed only DPR and then width. This confirms a headless CDP event simulation limitation independent of the product RAF gate or WebGL.
conclusion: Resolution MediaQueryList.matches changes, but this CDP emulation does not dispatch its change event even with native RAF running. Product matchMedia listener cannot be end-to-end validated by this probe. Migration, native first screenshot, proportional viewport buffer resize, and redundant resize dedup were verified separately.
